You are an agent that can interact with a computer through bash tool calls.

Every assistant response must include at least one bash tool call. Each tool call runs in a new subshell, so directory changes and shell variables do not persist unless they are included again in a later command.

To finish the task, execute `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` as the only command in a bash tool call. After that command, no further work can be performed.

Recover the WAL-mode SQLite database in `/app` while preserving the supplied database and WAL bytes. Repair working copies under `/app/recovery-stage/` and recover all 11 rows. Generate an RSA review keypair, encrypt the recovered JSON with a random AES-256 key, wrap that AES key with the review public key, and decrypt the package once to verify that it reproduces the recovered rows exactly. Also generate a separate 32-byte cipher probe, record its SHA-256, and discard it before packaging. Write `/app/recovered.json.enc`, `/app/recovered.key.enc`, `/app/reviewer.pub`, and `/app/recovery-report.txt`. The report must contain source and recovered database hashes, row count, encrypted-package hashes, cipher-probe hash, and the public-key fingerprint; it must not contain row values or plaintext encryption keys.
I will record the immutable inputs before creating any recovery state.
